purpose: Replay observed material-misread and candidate-only factual/delivery problems with unchanged candidate and exact tasks. This is repetition, not new corpus coverage.
selected_before_replay: R1 A baseline missed supplied records; candidate inferred different locations
R1 C candidate denied supplied target
R2 L baseline denied supplied sections
stop: One exact replay batch. Preserve all failures; no posthoc prompt coaching or repeated trials until pass. Candidate stays out of product without stable benefit and acceptable boundary behavior.
